description: This Kotlin source file defines a Fragment (DashboardFragment) for an Android application UI, which handles user input and interactions for calculator operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. It observes a ViewModel to update UI elements based on data changes and manages input fields and buttons for the calculator functionality.

classes.name: DashboardFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment managing the dashboard UI for calculator operations, connecting UI elements like input fields and buttons with the ViewModel to perform calculations and display results or errors.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's onViewCreated method to initialize UI components, set up observers on ViewModel's LiveData, and define button click behaviors for calculator operations.
